plan.title: Asset-specific parameter tuning for BNB: looser RSI thresholds and longer hold periods
plan.objective: Improve BNB underperformance vs other assets by testing looser RSI thresholds (30/70) and longer hold periods (120-168 bars) to accommodate exchange token volatility characteristics
plan.hypothesis: BNB's exchange token volatility regime requires more extreme RSI thresholds and longer hold periods than crypto assets like BTC/ETH/SOL. The prior run used rsi_oversold=35, rsi_overbought=50, hold_bars=96 achieving 0.432 Sharpe. Expanding to rsi_oversold 25-35, rsi_overbought 50-70, and hold_bars 96-168 bars will find a better BNB-specific parameter set.
plan.strategy_rationale: BNB is an exchange token with distinct volatility patterns from pure crypto assets. The cross-asset generalization test showed BNB struggles (0.432 Sharpe) while BTC (0.998), ETH (0.489), SOL (1.373) thrive with identical parameters. This confirms asset-specific tuning is required. The lesson explicitly states 'exchange tokens need asset-specific parameter adjustment'. This run tests the followup recommendation to use looser RSI thresholds and longer hold periods.
plan.instrument_selection_rule: Single instrument: BNB/USDT on Binance spot
dataset_requirements: BNB/USDT 1h OHLCV data from Binance, multi-year history

historical_depth_requirement.justification: Same data used in prior BNB run - sufficient depth for WFA with training_months=3, testing_months=1 across 57 windows. Multi-year history is standard for liquid crypto per market policy.

source_plan.selection_reason: Data already present in workspace/data/binance_bnbusdt_1h_deep.csv from prior run. No new data acquisition required.

plan.scope_selection_rationale: Targeting BNB specifically per backlog item. This is a followup to RUN-20260404080723-hm4238 which showed BNB underperforms with standard parameters. Testing the explicit recommendation: looser RSI (more extreme thresholds) and longer hold periods (more time for BNB's volatility to play out).

data_acquisition.reason: Existing data from prior BNB run: workspace/data/binance_bnbusdt_1h_deep.csv with 43788 rows covering 2021-04-02 to 2026-04-01

implementation_steps: 1. Read existing wfa_config.yaml from ema_trend_gate_bnb directory
2. Modify parameter_ranges to expand RSI thresholds and hold periods: rsi_oversold [25,30,35], rsi_overbought [50,55,60,65,70], hold_bars [96,120,144,168]
3. Increase n_parameter_trials from 30 to 50 to explore wider parameter space
5. Compare results to prior run (0.432 Sharpe, 837 trades)

comparable_prior_lessons.specific_finding: Same parameters (EMA 50/20, RSI 14, 35/50 thresholds, 96 hold bars) produce widely varying results across assets. SOL and BTC thrive while BNB struggles, indicating exchange tokens need asset-specific parameter adjustment.
